notice: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA. Ground truth for a fictional letter written for evaluation only. Not a real document; all personal data is invented.

summary_points.en: This is your 2025 income tax assessment. You owe an additional 412.00 euros.
summary_points.tr: Bu, 2025 yılı gelir vergisi tahakkuk kararın. 412,00 euro ek ödeme yapman gerekiyor.

summary_points.en: From now on you must make quarterly income tax prepayments of 103.00 euros.
summary_points.tr: Bundan sonra üç ayda bir 103,00 euro gelir vergisi peşin ödemesi yapman gerekiyor.
summary_points.source_quote: Die Vorauszahlungen zur Einkommensteuer werden auf vierteljährlich 103,00 Euro festgesetzt.

summary_points.en: The home office costs you claimed were not accepted; the daily flat rate for 210 days (1,260 euros) was used instead.
summary_points.tr: Beyan ettiğin çalışma odası giderleri kabul edilmedi; onun yerine 210 gün için günlük götürü tutar (1.260 euro) dikkate alındı.
summary_points.source_quote: Statt der beantragten Aufwendungen für ein häusliches Arbeitszimmer wurde die Tagespauschale für 210 Tage (1.260 Euro) berücksichtigt

summary_points.en: Late payment costs 1 percent of the unpaid amount for every started month.
summary_points.tr: Geç ödemede, ödenmeyen tutarın başlayan her ay için yüzde 1'i gecikme zammı olarak alınır.
summary_points.source_quote: ist für jeden angefangenen Monat der Säumnis ein Säumniszuschlag von 1 Prozent des rückständigen Betrags zu entrichten (§ 240 AO).

summary_points.en: Filing an objection does not cancel the obligation to pay.
summary_points.tr: İtiraz etmek ödeme yükümlülüğünü ortadan kaldırmaz.
summary_points.source_quote: Durch die Einlegung eines Einspruchs wird die Zahlungspflicht nicht aufgehoben.

description.en: Pay the additional tax of 412.00 euros.

deadlines.source_quote: Bitte zahlen Sie den Betrag von 412,00 Euro spätestens am 26.10.2026.

deadlines.recurrence: Quarterly on 10 March, 10 June, 10 September and 10 December.

description.en: First quarterly tax prepayment of 103.00 euros.
description.tr: 103,00 euroluk ilk üç aylık vergi peşin ödemesi.

deadlines.source_quote: Die erste Vorauszahlung ist am 10.12.2026 fällig, danach jeweils am 10.03., 10.06., 10.09. und 10.12. eines Jahres.

deadlines.rule: One month, starting at the end of the day the notice is deemed delivered (by simple letter: the fourth day after posting, unless it arrived later).
deadlines.uncertainty_reason: The posting date is not stated in the letter and the deadline depends on actual delivery. The app must show the rule and must not present a single computed date as certain.

description.en: Deadline to file an objection (Einspruch) if you disagree with the assessment.
description.tr: Karara katılmıyorsan itiraz (Einspruch) için son tarih.

deadlines.source_quote: Die Frist für die Einlegung des Einspruchs beträgt einen Monat.

description.en: Pay 412.00 euros by 26 October 2026 and include your tax number (Steuernummer) as reference.
description.tr: 26 Ekim 2026'ya kadar 412,00 euro öde ve açıklamaya vergi numaranı (Steuernummer) yaz.

actions.source_quote: Geben Sie bei der Überweisung bitte Ihre Steuernummer an.

description.en: Pay 103.00 euros every quarter, starting on 10 December 2026.
description.tr: 10 Aralık 2026'dan başlayarak her üç ayda bir 103,00 euro öde.

actions.source_quote: Die erste Vorauszahlung ist am 10.12.2026 fällig, danach jeweils am 10.03., 10.06., 10.09. und 10.12. eines Jahres.

condition.en: If you disagree with the assessment

description.en: File an objection with the tax office in writing, electronically or in person within one month; you still have to pay meanwhile.
description.tr: Bir ay içinde vergi dairesine yazılı, elektronik olarak veya şahsen itiraz et; bu arada ödeme yapman yine de gerekiyor.

actions.source_quote: Dieser Bescheid kann mit dem Einspruch angefochten werden.

eval_notes: Tests three deadline types in one letter: a fixed due date, a recurring prepayment schedule, and a relative objection deadline that depends on delivery and must be flagged as uncertain. Also checks that the app does not suggest the objection pauses payment.
